title: Molecular Design and Simulation Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. Generates candidate molecular structures and evaluates them with appropriate computational models. A proposed engine for molecular invention: it generates candidate molecular structures aimed at desired properties, then evaluates them with appropriate computational models — from fast approximations to high-fidelity simulations — ranking candidates for real-world synthesis and testing.
